*  1. * File-> New-> Other -> Empty EMF Project and give a name to your project
http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/0.Select_Empty_Emf_Project_Wizard.png
*  2. * Open UNICASE perspective and right click on project you want to generate Ecore model from and select Generate Ecore
http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/1.Create_Empty_EMF_Project.png

http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/2.GenerateEcoreModel.png
*  3. *  Select model-Folder of your EMF Project and give name for your .ecore File
http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/2.2.SelectModelFolder.png
*  4. * Change to Java perspective and refresh your EMF Project and you see your .ecore File
*  5. *In Ecore Editor right click on your package and select *Load Ressource* and then click on Browse Workspace 
http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/4.Load_Source.png
*  6. *select org.unicase.model/model/model.ecore
5.Select_Org_Unicase_Model.png
*  7. * Set in Properties (double click on each Class) for all classes ESuperTypes to UnicaseModelElement
http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/
*  8. * Set Name to your_package_name, NS Prefix to org.unicase.model.your_package_name  and NS URI http://org.unicase.model.your_package_name (spaces in names are not allowed)
http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/
*  9. * Right click on your package and select Validate from the context menu
http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/
*  10. *Change to Java prespective
*  11. * File-> New-> Other -> EMF Generator Model and set name for example your_ecore_model_name.genmodel -> Next
http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/
*  12. * Ecore Model (Select Model Importer) -> Next (Ecore Import) -> Browse workspace and select your ecore file -> Next
http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/
*  13. * Select as root package only your own package, select all packages in Referenced generator model too.
*  14. *Finish
* 15. *Now open the gemodel (double click)
http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/
*  16. * Double click on root element and set in the properties All-> Base Package to org.unicase.model and click to save
http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/
*  17. * Double click on package element and set in the properties these fields:
   * All 
      * Compilance Level - 5.0
      * Copyright Fields - true
      * Copyright Text - hier you should paste your  copyright
http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/
   * Edit
      * Edit Directory - project_name/src
   * Editor
      * Editor Directory - org.unicase.modelExample/src
http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/
   * Model
      * Containment Proxies - true
      * Model Directory - /org.unicase.modelExample/src
http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/
   * Template & Merge
      * Code Formatting - true
http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/
